messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED: High latency & 502 rate increasing for /v1/generate (region: us-west-2). Pager auto-triggered.

incident-bot: Pager details -> priority: P1, alert_rule: generate-api-5xx-latency, triggered_at: 2750001234. War room auto-created: https://warroom.redwood-internal/incident/2750001234

emma (oncall): Acked. I'm joining the war room now. Paging devon and santiago.

devon (eng): On it, joining. Any immediate customer reports?

lia (support): We've got two customers on chat complaining about timeouts for batch jobs hitting /v1/generate. No escalations yet, but ticket #5672 opened.

maya (product): Noted. I'll draft an initial status page blurb after we confirm impact.

emma (oncall): Quick triage: running `curl -s -D - -o /dev/null https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` shows intermittent 502 + 1.2s p95. Starting metric tail.

santiago (sre): Looking at infra dashboards — GPU queue depth on pool-gpu-3 spiked ~3x at 02:03Z, and autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough due to capacity limits. Also seeing increased cache-miss rate for KV prefix.

devon (eng): Reproducing locally: model workers report `RuntimeError: CUDA OOM` logs in last 2 minutes, followed by soft-restarts. Patching pod affinity didn't help. Pasting log tail:
```
[02:04:01] worker-12 ERROR RuntimeError: CUDA OOM while allocating 1.2GB
[02:04:02] worker-12 INFO restarting worker
[02:04:05] worker-7 WARN kvcache miss ratio 0.74
[02:04:10] proxy-01 ERROR upstream 502 read timeout
```

emma (oncall): Immediate mitigation plan proposals? Options: 1) scale up reserve workers (if capacity) 2) temporarily route lower-priority customers to model-quantized variant 3) enable backpressure/queue cap to shed traffic.

santiago (sre): I'm checking reserved capacity; small buffers available in us-west-2 but will take ~60s to attach GPUs. I'll request a manual scale now.

devon (eng): While SRE scales, I'll flip routing rule to divert non-enterprise tier to model-redwood-lite-quant for reads. Command I plan to run:
```
redwoodctl route update --match tier!=enterprise --target model-redwood-lite-quant --timeout 1m
```

emma (oncall): Please add a canary header so we can observe error rates before fully switching.

devon (eng): Will do `--canary 5%` first. Pushing in 10s.

lia (support): Updating customers: "We're aware of increased timeouts in generation endpoints in us-west-2. Engineers are investigating; mitigations underway. We'll update within 15 minutes." Any edits?

maya (product): Add ETA: initial mitigation expected in ~5-10m. Note that some long-running batch jobs may still be impacted.

incident-bot: Status page draft suggestion:
"We are investigating elevated latency and errors for text generation (us-west-2). Impact: some API requests return 502 or see higher latency. Mitigation: routing adjustments and capacity scale-up in progress. Next update within 15 minutes."

emma (oncall): Approved. Lia please post to status.redwood.ai once devon confirms canary success or after capacity attach.

(devon runs canary)
devon (eng): Canary at 5% started -> no spike in errors for canary traffic in first 45s. Increasing to 25% now.

santiago (sre): Manual GPU attach requested; cloud team ack'd. Expected ready in ~70s.

devon (eng): Canary 25% holding. Error rate trending down from 12%->3% on affected routes.

emma (oncall): Good. Proceed to 100% routing to quantized variant for non-enterprise to reduce pressure. Keep enterprise on old path.

devon (eng): Switched to 100% for non-enterprise. Confirming metrics... p95 latency for non-enterprise dropped 40%, 502s down to ~1%.

santiago (sre): GPU pool attached at 02:06Z, added 4 nodes. Workers started and OOM logs subsiding. Observed a ~20% reduction in overall queue depth.

emma (oncall): Okay, let's keep the routing change for 15 minutes while traffic stabilizes. After that we can gradually move traffic back to main model.

lia (support): Status page posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2750001234 - "Mitigation in progress: traffic diversion and capacity scale-up implemented. Users may experience intermittent errors; under active investigation."

maya (product): I'll prepare a short customer notification for larger impacted customers. Lia can you DM me list of affected accounts?

lia (support): On it. Sending list to maya and emma.

emma (oncall): Small checklist before handing off: 1) ensure no regressions 2) collect eval prompt set for quality comparison 3) confirm autoscaler config to prevent recurrence.

devon (eng): Capturing a quick qual check for quantized outputs vs baseline on sampled prompts. Initial diffs look acceptable for non-enterprise SLAs.

santiago (sre): I'll open a post-incident task to review autoscaler thresholds and warm-pool sizing. Assigning to infra-owner after war room.

emma (oncall): I'm going to leave the war room in 25m; devon and santiago, please keep monitoring. If all stable at +20m mark, I'll update status to "degraded - monitoring" and clear pager.

devon (eng): Will monitor logs and metrics. Setting alert for residual OOMs.

lia (support): Customers in chat reporting improvements. No new tickets opened in the last 3 minutes.

emma (oncall): Thanks all. If anything changes ping here and re-escalate. Otherwise we aim to transition out of active war room in ~30m and create follow-up retrospective.

incident-bot: Reminder: create incident timeline and fill template before close: https://go.redwood/incident-template

emma (oncall): Acknowledged. Creating timeline now.

(devon, santiago continue monitoring; thread remains open for follow-ups)
